t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are 4 sets of two pairs of gnomes that always come in the same colour combinations. The size, shape and clothes of the gnomes dont matter, it is only the colour. Each pair of gnomes will take you to one of two forests, one is light coloured and one is dark coloured. The mushrooms you can get from each forest are random but there is a certain skill to collecting the most, it seems like I should keep track of the correc tcolour gnome

vb_textbox.text: Hello, you are going to complete an experiment involving gnomes and mushrooms. I have just completed this and have some advice based on what happened to me.There are 4 pairs of gnomes that will show up. They always appear in the same pairs, which are.Green and PinkRed and YellowOrange/Gold and BrownBlue and PurpleSelecting one of the gnomes takes you to a forest. There are two forests in the game, one with a red basket and one with a yellow basket. Gnomes of a certain colour take you to the same forest each time. These are:Green, Red, Orange/Gold, Blue = Take you to the forest with the red basketPink, Yellow, Brown, Purple = Take you to the forest with the yellow basket.You will find that over time the balance of mushrooms goes up and down, which I believe is synchronous with each other. Like the forests are on a see-saw when the yellow basket forest has lots of mushrooms, the red basket forest has few. When you start to see the mushroom level drop below 4 or 5 mushrooms, switch to the other forest to see if it is going up, and adjust your selections accordingly.The size, shape and design of the gnome does not appear to alter anything, it is based on the current level of mushrooms in the forest which goes up and down randomly.
